Postconfig saves the file before evaluation, so the getter reads the final committed state.
Both conditions together precisely and completely verify the instruction requirements.

metadata.explanation: Agent must move slide 24 (Works Cited reference list, the last slide) to become slide 1. Total slide count stays at 24. Evaluator checks that the first slide contains 'Purdue OWL Family' (a phrase unique to slide 24) and count is still 24. Initial state has 'MLA 8th Edition...' as slide 1, which fails the check.
metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent scrolled to end of 24-slide presentation, selected last two slides (23 and 24), duplicated them via right-click context menu, and saved. Failed at step 6 when attempting to reorder.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can scroll slide panel, select individual slides by clicking, use right-click context menu (Cut/Paste or Move Slide), Ctrl+S save
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent could not reorder slides after duplication. This task focuses on a simple cut-and-paste move of a single slide.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the slide reordering capability that was the root of the failure. Simplified to moving just the last slide (no duplication). Uses Cut/Paste from context menu or drag-and-drop in the slide panel.
